blue-eyed-raven.description: He has pale red skin, blonde hair and light blue eyes. He has deer ears and has a green hood with a light green triangle sign printed on it. He wears a green coat with blue sleeves and a light green scarf. He has white pants and brown boots.

darksteel-dullahan.name: Darksteel Dullahan
darksteel-dullahan.description: "An epic hidden in the darkness, a hero guarding the dawn, destined to sound the horn of battle at daybreak."
darksteel-dullahan.story: "An epic hidden in the darkness, a hero guarding the dawn, destined to sound the horn of battle at daybreak."
darksteel-dullahan.capabilities: A powerful Tank whose Umbral Aegis blocks massive single hits. She also excels in Damage Reduction, Control Immunity, and Energy Restoration.

eclipse-arlott.name: Eclipse Arlott
eclipse-arlott.description: Half-Demon. A tragic figure with white hair and eyes of mismatched colors. An outsider to both demons and humans. Arlott, born of human and demon blood, was betrayed by both races. At death's door, he was saved by a human girl named Mila and found peace in a quiet life. But their happiness was short-lived. When the Church of Light executed Mila for helping him, Arlott, consumed by rage, broke through the ranks of knights in the church and laid Mila to rest in a place filled with their shared memories... (official introduction)
eclipse-arlott.story: Half-Demon. A tragic figure with white hair and eyes of mismatched colors. An outsider to both demons and humans. Arlott, born of human and demon blood, was betrayed by both races. At death's door, he was saved by a human girl named Mila and found peace in a quiet life. But their happiness was short-lived. When the Church of Light executed Mila for helping him, Arlott, consumed by rage, broke through the ranks of knights in the church and laid Mila to rest in a place filled with their shared memories... (official introduction)
eclipse-arlott.capabilities: A durable Fighter hero with strong Control, excels at countering enemy Mages and Marksmen. Deals high DMG and inflicts Control when enemies gather.

edith.name: Edith
edith.description: A tank hero that possesses immense durability and the ability to control enemies. In mecha form, she can absorb large amounts of damage; in human form, she trades this durability for continuous damage and the ability to inflict debuffs against her enemies.
